Definition: Is the register integrated with the government's national data exchange system?
Comments: Kontaktu enables data exchange with other gov entities (customs, treasury, banks)
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Kontaktu is operational for e-filing and e-payment (via banks and mobile money operators MTM/Orange), and a 2025 DGCI notice confirms NIF issuance now runs through an integrated SIGEF module. However, IMF technical assistance reporting (2020, reiterated in the 2025 IMF Selected Issues paper, Country Report 25/168) states that systematic data exchange between DGCI, Customs (DGA), Treasury and Social Security has still not started despite signed agreements. 'Under development' (3) remains the best-supported rating — note this falls short of full integration implied by the original comment; unchanged but re-sourced.
